artworks.title: Hurlingham
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with sailboats on the water. The horizon shows trees and buildings. The brushwork or etching technique is detailed, highlighting the sailboats and their reflections in the water. The color palette is predominantly black, gray, and pale tones. The buildings and trees in the distance blend harmoniously with the still water and boats.

artworks.title: Une rencontre de jouyeauz augures
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures dressed in ancient-style garments, engaging in an interaction. The scene depicts two figures in togas, one with hands behind his back and the other with hands at his sides. Both figures have exaggerated facial expressions. The background features simple structures and birds in the sky. The style is reminiscent of traditional lithographs with strong contrasts and sketch-like quality. French text below the image suggests a satirical context.

artworks.title: La Marchande de Moutarde
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a doorway or interior space. One person is on the left, facing inward, while the second person is on the right, slightly leaning forward and extending their hands. The person on the left has their hair tied back and is dressed in a long garment. The other person also has their hair tied back and wears a long-sleeved dress. The space includes shelves with containers and pottery. The doorway is framed by textured stone or brick.

artworks.dimensions:

artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a bustling square surrounded by grand European architecture. The scene includes a clock tower in the distance and figures in the foreground and background. Details such as towers and domes add to the historical cityscape atmosphere.

artworks.title: Rag Pickers, Quartier Mouffetard, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: Two individuals are shown in an interior setting. The person on the left is seated, with long flowing hair and delicate features. They are surrounded by objects on a table. The individual on the right is standing, wearing a broad-brimmed hat and loose garment. The background includes textured walls and hanging cloths or tapestries, creating a cozy atmosphere. The space appears narrow and filled with textures and lines.

artworks.title: Reading by Lamplight
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)

artworks.title: Rotherhithe
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals sitting from the chest upwards. The person on the left has curly dark hair and a side profile. The person on the right is closer to the foreground, wearing a cap and visibly showing a nose and mustache. Both individuals wear simple late 19th-century clothing. The person on the right appears to be holding a pipe. The background contains various sailing ships with tall masts docked at a harbor. In the distance are more ships and outlines of buildings under a cloudy sky. The scene is framed within architectural features that indicate a waterfront view, possibly from inside a structure.

artworks.title: The Traghetto, No. 2
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an archway and open space, evoking a courtyard. The view is slightly angled, revealing the covered area and a distant section with a small cart or horse-drawn carriage. The horizon is obscured by the arch and shadow, with dark foliage etched above. The etching technique consists of fine lines for shadows and textures, creating a soft quality. Figures are depicted on the left and seated individuals around a table on the right, adding depth and activity to the scene. The color palette is monochrome, using variations of sepia tones for an antique feel.

artworks.title: Soupe à Trois Sous
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several individuals seated at tables. The drawing depicts a casual setting where various individuals are seated around tables. Some tables have bottles and glasses. The lines are sketchy and expressively capture the informal atmosphere of the location. The scene is drawn with a focus on the interaction and posture of the individuals. Some individuals appear to be engaged in conversation or contemplation. The drawing uses a limited range of lines to convey depth and mood.

artworks.title: The Dancing Girl
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person standing. The figure is slightly angled to the right, with one arm extended outward and the other resting along their side. The person's facial features are not clearly defined, and they have wavy hair that falls below their ears. They are draped in a flowing garment that extends dramatically to one side. The individual is not wearing any jewelry or holding any objects. The sketch is set against a plain background.

artworks.title: Annie
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Mary E. Maxwell, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl standing. She is facing forward with her body slightly turned to the left. She has delicate facial features, a rounded face, and large eyes. Her hair is shoulder-length and wavy. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress with a high collar. Her hands are visible, with the right hand hanging down alongside her body. In the background, there is a simple and minimalistic texture. The artwork has a sketch-like appearance with fine lines and shading. There is text at the bottom and left side of the image, including the name "Annie" prominently featured.

artworks.title: James Jackson
artworks.artist: James B. Longacre, after Charles Balthazar Julien Févret de Saint-Mémin, William A. Wilmer engraver
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (partially trimmed): 11.59 × 9.21 cm (4 9/16 × 3 5/8 in.)
sheet: 15.56 × 9.37 cm (6 1/8 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile, seated with his right hand resting on a surface, holding an object resembling a book. He has a prominent nose, thin lips, and high cheekbones. His dark hair is styled in a late 18th to early 19th-century fashion, possibly tied with a ribbon. He is wearing a dark, high-collared coat with buttons over a white ruffled shirt with ruffles at the neck and cuffs. The background is dark with text that reads "JAMES JACKSON" and a signature.

artworks.title: The Little Pool
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum exchange, 1952)
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with two men in dark coats and hats leaning on a railing as they look at the bustling harbor. Small boats are scattered across the river with people paddling in some of them. In the distance, large ships are docked along the harbor with intricate rigging and masts pointing towards the sky. The city structures are faintly outlined in the background. The horizon is not clearly defined, blending into the cityscape. Loose, sketch-like brushstrokes and etching techniques are used to depict movement and an airy atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily black and gray, emphasizing depth and the active waterfront.

artworks.title: Rag Pickers, Quartier Mouffetard, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with two figures. The drawing depicts a rustic indoor space with rough and textured walls. There are two figures in the back of the room, one seated and the other standing. A table with bowls and items is between them. Shadows from the light source emphasize the textures of the space. The perspective leads the eye into the scene, showcasing the interior's humble characteristics. Textiles or cloth hang on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Annie, Seated
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a young girl sitting on a chair. She is seen from the waist up, in a relaxed posture with her hands in her lap. The girl's facial features are depicted with minimal detail, and she has long, wavy hair. She wears a long-sleeved dress. The background is simple, showing faint outlines of the chair and ground. The artist's signature and the name “Annie” are at the bottom of the etching.

artworks.title: The 'Adam and Eve', Old Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Josephine Boardman Crane, 1954)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with buildings along the water. A tall cylindrical tower is seen in the upper left corner. Sailing boats with tall masts are docked along the river. A small wooden rowboat is tied close to the viewer, with larger boats further away. The buildings exhibit intricate architectural details, and a few chimneys are visible in the background. The image is rendered in sepia tones, evoking an antique atmosphere.

artworks.title: Hurlingham
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a low angle view across a calm body of water with boats and buildings. The horizon line is high, marked by trees and structures. The boats dominate the right side, while buildings line the left. The technique uses fine brushstrokes, giving an ethereal quality. The color palette is monochromatic with tones of brown and gray, creating a serene atmosphere. The contrast between dark sails and lighter elements adds visual impact.

artworks.title: Soupe à Trois Sous
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with tables and chairs. The image depicts a rustic interior setting, likely a cafe or tavern, featuring several figures seated at tables. There is a table with a tray, a knife, and a glass. The lines are sketchy and loosely detailed, capturing an informal atmosphere. The background shows details such as the wooden roof and walls. The drawing employs techniques of etching or line drawing, indicated by fine lines and shaded areas.

artworks.title: The Tiny Pool
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a waterfront scene with docks, moored ships, and human figures. The style is sketch-like with expressive lines capturing textures in a monochromatic color palette of gray and black.

artworks.title: The Wine-Glass
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a coupe glass placed on a textured surface with a dark, intricate background. The color scheme is monochrome, using shades of black, gray, and white. The coupe glass is in the center, while the background is filled with dark cross-hatching textures.

artworks.title: Billingsgate
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a harbor scene showing various activities. Several sailboats are tightly lined up with their masts reaching up. A stairway on the left leads to buildings. People and animals are depicted with fine lines. The artwork has a monochromatic color scheme. In the distance, a bridge and skyline complete the harbor background.

artworks.title: The Forge
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene. The drawing depicts an interior space with a group of people engaging in various activities. The central element is an anvil or workbench, accompanied by a variety of long tools propped against the workbench. The space is characterized by wooden beams along the ceiling. On the right, there are shadows suggesting other elements like a table. The entire composition is rendered in a monochromatic palette, using cross-hatching techniques to create shading and texture. The use of line and shadow creates an impression of an industrious and somewhat historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Drouet
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man sitting with crossed arms. He has prominent facial features, including a noticeable nose, deep-set eyes, and a full beard. His hair is voluminous and tousled. He is wearing a loose-fitting shirt with a collar. There are no visible accessories or objects around him. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Fumette
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl seated, with her full body visible in the composition. She is positioned frontally, sitting with her hands resting on her lap, one hand placed atop the other. Her facial features include a serious expression with dark, prominent eyes and arched eyebrows. She has long, wavy hair that falls around her shoulders. The girl is wearing a long-sleeved dress with what appears to be a high collar and intricate fabric detailing. There is no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is plain, with sketch lines subtly indicating some texture but no specific details or scenery.
